summary.en: AI is penetrating US politics, with the industry pouring tens of millions of dollars into the midterms and voters starting to learn about candidates through chatbots. Reports say the number of "pink slime" websites using AI-generated content for political propaganda is growing.
summary.zh_hans: AI正渗透美国政治，业界向中期选举投入数千万美元资金，选民亦开始通过聊天机器人了解候选人。报道指，以AI生成内容作政治宣传的「粉红肉渣」网站数量正在增加。
summary.zh_hant: AI正滲透美國政治，業界向中期選舉投入數千萬美元資金，選民亦開始透過聊天機械人了解候選人。報道指，以AI生成內容作政治宣傳嘅「粉紅肉渣」網站數量正在增加。

title.en: AI becomes new channel for political propaganda as "pink slime" sites multiply

summary.en: The Environmental Protection Department announced that recyclable waste paper types will expand from the traditional "three papers" to paper bags, packaging boxes and wrapping paper, with full local pulping and recycling starting this Thursday. The department hopes the move will boost recycling volumes and reduce reliance on waste paper exports.
summary.zh_hans: 环境保护署宣布，可回收废纸种类由传统「三纸」扩展至纸袋、包装盒及包装纸，本周四起全面推行本地制浆回收。署方期望提升回收量，减少废纸出口依赖。
summary.zh_hant: 環境保護署宣布，可回收廢紙種類由傳統「三紙」擴展至紙袋、包裝盒及包裝紙，本周四起全面推行本地製漿回收。署方期望提升回收量，減少廢紙出口依賴。

title.en: Hong Kong expands recyclable waste paper types; full local pulping starts Thursday

summary.en: US President Donald Trump confirmed he will have dinner with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei this evening, reiterating his opposition to slowing AI development. Reuters reported Trump also intends to maintain America's lead over China in the AI race.

title.en: Trump confirms dinner with Anthropic CEO, says AI development should not slow down

summary.en: In a September 27 interview, Trump said the US and Iran are expected to hold a new round of talks this week, possibly resuming as early as today. summary.en: At about 8:53am, a green minibus collided with a truck on Fanling Highway toward Kowloon near Choi Yuen Estate, injuring about 20 people; the minibus driver was briefly trapped. The Transport Department closed the section in both directions and advised drivers to use alternative routes.

summary.zh_hant: 今朝約8時53分，一輛專線小巴喺粉嶺公路往九龍方向、近彩園邨同貨車相撞，約20人受傷，小巴司機一度被困。運輸署封閉該路段往來行車線，呼籲駕駛人士改用其他路線。

summary.en: The Transport Department said that as of August, about 40% of audible pedestrian-crossing "yellow boxes" across Hong Kong have been upgraded with street-name voice prompts and tactile maps for visually impaired users. The department will continue replacing the remaining units in phases.

summary.en: 87-year-old María Carmen Abarcas was evicted last Wednesday from her Madrid home of nearly 70 years, triggering a protest of at least tens of thousands on Saturday (Sep 26) demanding stronger tenant protections amid soaring housing costs. The case has reignited debate over Spain's housing crisis.

summary.zh_hant: 87歲婦人María Carmen Abarcas上周三被逐出居住近70年嘅馬德里住所，觸發上周六（9月26日）至少數萬人上街示威，要求加強租客保障，抗議住屋成本飈升。事件再度燃起西班牙房屋危機嘅爭議。

title.en: Tens of thousands protest in Madrid over soaring housing costs after eviction of 87-year-old

summary.en: Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic announced his resignation on Sunday, ending his second and final five-year term seven months early and paving the way for early presidential elections. The move comes ahead of the October 25 snap parliamentary vote, allowing him to lead his Progressive Party's campaign and potentially become prime minister. Parliament Speaker Ana Brnabic will serve as interim president until the election, due within 90 days.
summary.zh_hans: 塞尔维亚总统武契奇星期日宣布辞职，结束其第二个亦是最后一个五年任期，较任期提早七个月，为提前举行总统大选铺路。他将率领执政进步党出战10月25日提前举行的国会大选，有机会出任总理。国会议长布尔纳比奇将担任临时总统，新一届总统选举须在90日内举行。
summary.zh_hant: 塞爾維亞總統武契奇星期日宣布辭職，結束其第二個亦是最後一個五年任期，較任期提早七個月，為提前舉行總統大選鋪路。他將率領執政進步黨出戰10月25日提前舉行嘅國會大選，有機會出任總理。國會議長布爾納比奇將擔任臨時總統，新一屆總統選舉須在90日內舉行。

title.en: Serbia's President Vucic resigns ahead of snap elections

summary.en: Hong Kong will see a few showers with hot and mainly fine weather today, with urban temperatures reaching around 33 degrees, the Observatory says. Super Typhoon Sharki has intensified and is tracking near Japan's Ryukyu Islands, while a northeast monsoon is expected to bring cloudier skies and showers to southern China later this week.
summary.zh_hans: 天文台预测，本港今日早晚部分时间多云，有一两阵骤雨，日间大致天晴及酷热，市区最高气温约33度。超强台风舒力基集结在冲绳岛以东约280公里，预料向东北偏东移动；一股东北季候风将在本周后期逐渐影响华南，该区云量较多及有几阵骤雨。
summary.zh_hant: 天文台預測，本港今日早晚部份時間多雲，有一兩陣驟雨，日間大致天晴及酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度。超強颱風舒力基集結在沖繩島以東約280公里，預料向東北偏東移動；一股東北季候風將在本周後期逐漸影響華南，該區雲量較多及有幾陣驟雨。

title.en: HK to hit 33°C today as Super Typhoon Sharki intensifies; showers expected later this week

summary.en: Mainland markets will close for the National Day holiday from October 1 to 7, with Stock Connect northbound services suspended during the break. summary.zh_hant: 內地A股將於10月1日至7日國慶長假休市，滬深港股通期間暫停服務；港股10月1日休市一天。本周迎來第三季度收官，缺乏「北水」資金支持下，大市成交料趨冷清，市場焦點轉向美國即將公布嘅PCE通脹及非農就業數據。

title.en: Northbound funds pause for National Day holiday; HK turnover expected to stay quiet
